name: Unwelcome Spirits

angles.text: For those who commune with the elements, the natural wind spirits' departure and the hollows' arrival point to a deep disturbance in the local balance of air.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are an order seeking to learn why the spirits of the wind abandoned them and how to bring them back. Their inquiries now focus on strange occurrences that began after the spirits disappeared.
Hollows are strange wind sprites that appeared in Shadowgale Forest after the original wind spirits departed. Their origins and nature remain unknown, so scholars gather their essences for study.
Shadowgale Forest lies to the north. Strange wind hollows have appeared there since the area's elemental spirits departed.
No one knows why the spirits of the wind vanished. The Windshapers seek the cause and hope to restore communion with them.
faq.q: Why did the wind spirits leave?

faq.answer: The Windshapers gather essences from dispersed hollows for study. They hope these remains will reveal what brought the beings into existence after the spirits departed.
faq.q: Why are Wind Hollow Essences being gathered?

faq.answer: The hollows are unwelcome intruders that appeared when the natural spirits were gone. Their spread through Shadowgale Forest calls for dispersal so the region is protected and specimens can be gathered.

sections.body: The Windshapers have lost communion with the spirits of the wind. They seek to learn why the spirits left and what might bring them back. Their departure has left a void in the local elemental atmosphere.
sections.title: The Vanished Spirits

sections.body: After the wind spirits departed, strange sprites called hollows appeared in Shadowgale Forest to the north. The Windshapers had not known of them before the spirits vanished. The hollows seem tied to the spirits’ absence, and their essences may help reveal what they are.
sections.title: Shadows in Shadowgale

summary: The Windshapers seek the spirits of the wind, gone from their reach. Now hollows appear in Shadowgale Forest, and the order gathers their essences to learn what drove the true spirits away.
